core.why: armor pen for the late game

Tristana.line: vs Tristana: loses the lvl 2 all-in, wins after 2 items. Don't fight before 3.

Draven.line: vs Draven: he wins early trades. Farm safe, root him when he catches an axe.

Caitlyn.line: vs Caitlyn: she out-ranges you. Farm with Q feathers, all-in when her trap is down.

Ezreal.line: vs Ezreal: poke lane. Stand behind minions, punish when his E is down.

Jinx.line: vs Jinx: you win lvl 2-5 if E roots land. Don't let her scale for free.

Kai'Sa.line: vs Kai'Sa: even lane, you win 2-item fights. Respect her lvl 6 dive.

Lucian.line: vs Lucian: he wins short trades. Trade only when your W is up.

Samira.line: vs Samira: root her before she reaches melee. Mercurial if she gets fed.

Ashe.line: vs Ashe: she slows, you root. Take Cleanse if her R keeps landing.

Vayne.line: vs Vayne: bully her early. She outscales unless you are two items ahead.

Miss Fortune.line: vs Miss Fortune: dodge Q bounces behind minions; her R is stopped by your R.

Jhin.line: vs Jhin: poke lane. Trade when he reloads; his 4th shot is the threat.

Zeri.line: vs Zeri: she scales harder. Push early, root her when she dashes in.

Smolder.line: vs Smolder: bully him before stacks. Do not let him farm freely.

Sivir.line: vs Sivir: her shield eats one E root. Bait the shield, then commit.

Aphelios.line: vs Aphelios: watch his weapon; all-in during Gravitum/Infernum windows.

notes: Base path follows docs/design.md 5.3. LDR is the default armor-pen slot; the anti-heal rule swaps it to Mortal Reminder.
op.gg 16.17: Yun Tal -> Navori -> IE is the most-picked line (32%), the ER line is second (25%).
Matchup lines are hand-written and short by design; they are the 'why', not a guide.
